name: BASELINE_GROOT_V1

paper_citations.target_scenario: Interactive mobile volumetric streaming to a mobile device (single-user focus); Sec.4 System Overview p.5; Fig.6 architecture p.5
paper_citations.topology: Server encodes/adapts PD-Tree stream to client mobile device; Fig.6 p.5; Sec.5 pipeline p.6–7
paper_citations.transport: Wireless networking to mobile client; not MoQ multicast. Related work mentions DASH-compliant systems (p.12) but GROOT contribution is PD-Tree + parallel decode + view/distance adaptation
paper_citations.delivery_semantics: Per-viewer user-adaptive streaming (frustum culling Sec.6.1 p.8; distance LOD Sec.6.2). No cross-user fan-out/coalescing described.
paper_citations.independent_stream: Yes — adaptations driven by that user viewpoint/distance (Sec.6 p.8)
paper_citations.cross_user_fanout: Not present in original architecture (single interactive viewer framing)
paper_citations.shared_representation_decision: No multi-user shared representation decision in paper
paper_citations.controller_placement: Server-side real-time adaptation using PD-Tree independence (Sec.6 p.8)
paper_citations.adaptation_inputs: User view frustum, distance, bandwidth constraints (Sec.6)
paper_citations.content_unit: PD-Tree nodes / points (OBB/ODB/OCB); Sec.5 p.6–7; Fig.9 decoder p.7
paper_citations.buffering: Client render/decode pipeline with GPU/CPU hybrid decode (Sec.5.3 p.7)
paper_citations.quality_bitrate: Resolution adaptation by distance; culling reduces bitrate (Sec.6)
paper_citations.prediction_horizon: Continuous on-demand view adaptation (not Rolling POT window)
paper_citations.metrics: Decode fps, compression, mobile performance (Sec.3/8 evaluation framing)
paper_citations.limitations_vs_our_media: Original PD-Tree/octree volumetric codec not reproduced on H.264 Rep ladder → DASH code correctly labels GROOT-inspired

invalid_path.entry: moq_cluster_Sigcomm.py --strategy groot / strategies/groot_controller.py on shared MoQ
invalid_path.classification: INVALID_SHARED_DELIVERY_IMPLEMENTATION when shared track fan-out present

dash_pc_policy: DASH-PC/PCC-DASH removed from active matrices; never rename historical DASH-PC dirs as GROOT
